name: Oklahoma City
local_rules: Oklahoma City (OKC) requires a 'Not Guilty' plea to be entered on or before the 'Arraignment Date' written on the bottom of the ticket. To have a trial, you must post a bond equal to the amount of the ticket plus a $35.00 bond fee. Failure to take action by the arraignment date causes the fine to increase (e.g., $15 meter tickets jump to $24). Always include the citation number on the check or money order to ensure your bond is processed for the correct case.
